Aline, Bond talent to Business E’ una Boutique specializzata in Strategic Search e Leadership Transformation, agendo da ponte tra talento e business. Si rivolge a realtà multinazionali e aziende imprenditoriali in trasformazione. Lavora libera da schemi predefiniti, è guidata dalla reali esigenze delle organizzazioni valutandone la specifica fase evolutiva. Non cerca solo il ruolo ma il differenziale che la persona può agire per generare un impatto misurabile. Job Title: E-Commerce Manager Location : Lombardia Industry: FMCG (Fast-Moving Consumer Goods) Aline cura la selezione per conto di una solida e dinamica realtà del settore FMCG, alla ricerca del proprio E-Commerce Manager. La risorsa definirà e guiderà la strategia di crescita del canale digital & e-commerce (Pure Players, Marketplace e D2C), ottimizzando le performance di vendita, la presenza dei brand sul canale digitale e l'esperienza cliente, operando in forte sinergia con i team Sales, Marketing e Supply Chain. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Strategia & Business Development: d efinizione, sviluppo e implementazione del piano strategico E-Commerce (B2C e B2B/e-Retail) in coerenza con gli obiettivi commerciali del Gruppo, definendo budget, sales forecast e strategie di pricing/promozione. Gestione Canali Digitali & Marketplace: coordinamento e ottimizzazione delle vendite su Piattaforme Proprietaire (D2C), Marketplace (es. Amazon) e e-Retailers/Grocery Online, garantendo la corretta visibilità dei prodotti e la massima conversione. Digital Marketing & Performance: pianificazione ed esecuzione delle campagne di digital marketing (PPC, SEO/SEM, CRM e Retail Media) finalizzate all'acquisizione, fidelizzazione e all'aumento del Lifetime Value del cliente. Data Analysis & Reporting: monitoraggio costante dei principali KPI di canale (Conversion Rate, CAC, ROAS, AOV), analisi delle vendite e predisposizione della reportistica periodica per la Direzione Strategica. Operation & Cross-Functional Alignment: collaborazione attiva con le funzioni Supply Chain, Logistics e Customer Care per garantire un'eccellente execution operativa, la gestione del magazzino e un'ottima customer experience. WHAT YOU CAN BRING TO THE COMPANY Comprovata esperienza (almeno 5-7 anni) nella gestione di canali E-Commerce, idealmente matura all'interno del settore FMCG, Consumer Goods o Retail. Solide competenze in ambito Retail Media, Trade Marketing Digitale, Digital Performance e web analytics (es. Google Analytics). Profonda conoscenza dei principali CRM, CMS/Piattaforme E-commerce (es. Shopify, Magento, Salesforce Commerce Cloud) e dei logaritmi di posizionamento sui Marketplace. Orientamento analitico, spiccate doti comunicative e capacità di gestire progetti complessi in un contesto fast-paced. Ottime doti relazionali, spirito imprenditoriale e fluente conoscenza della lingua inglese (scritta e parlata). YOU ARE ENERGIZED BY Guidare la digital transformation e la crescita delle vendite online di brand iconici nel settore FMCG. Analizzare trend e dati per cogliere nuove opportunità di mercato e trasformare gli insight in azioni ad alto impatto commerciale. Lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e cross-funzionale, collaborando strettamente con i team Sales, Marketing e Logistics. Sperimentare nuove tecnologie, strumenti di Retail Media e strategie omnicanale per ingaggiare il consumatore finale. WHAT THE COMPANY OFFERS Retribuzione: RAL €65.000 - €75.000 in base alla seniority. Incentivi : MBO pari a circa il 20% della RAL. Benefit: Auto aziendale e piano Welfare integrato. 📩 Per candidarsi allegare il proprio CV aggiornato. Rattachement Direction stratégie & développement Travail transverse avec sales, produit, data, marketing, communication et direction générale. Finalité du poste Construire et piloter la stratégie de croissance de Mobsuccess sur l’ensemble de ses offres media et contenu, en développant à la fois : une machine d’ inbound marketing capable de générer de la visibilité, des leads qualifiés et de la préférence de marque ; une machine d’ outbound marketing capable d’équiper les équipes business avec des campagnes, contenus, séquences et stratégies performantes ; une logique de go-to-market cohérente avec le positionnement Mobsuccess et synchronisé avec les autres actions marketing et communication Profil recherché Nous recherchons un profil ayant une capacité à construire les outils (appétence tech), les messages, les séquences, à les tester, à évaluer les performances et itérer sur l’ensemble des missions du poste. Le candidat doit être à l’aise dans le travail cross-équipe, mettre “la main à la pâte” dans un premier temps puis ensuite développer l’équipe growth. Il doit développer sa vision de la meilleure approche growth pour Mobsuccess, la soutenir auprès du comité de direction puis la mener à bien. Contexte Mobsuccess a pour mission de permettre à tous les commerces (petits et grands) de communiquer simplement et efficacement en digital. Mobsuccess met en avant une proposition de valeur unifiée autour de Media x Content , avec une ambition de simplifier et clarifier ses offres, de renforcer l’unicité de la marque. Le rôle doit contribuer à transformer cette ambition en dispositif concret de croissance, avec une logique d’offres lisibles, de preuves, de contenus, de campagnes et d’activation commerciale. MISSIONS PRINCIPALES : Le poste comporte 3 piliers : générer de la demande, la nourrir, et l'activer. Pilier 1 — Inbound & Demand Generation Construire la stratégie d'acquisition inbound de A à Z : définir les ICP, personas, pains, objections et déclencheurs business par segment et par vertical. Concevoir la stratégie éditoriale orientée demande (contenus experts, cas clients, benchmarks, POVs, pages offres et verticales) et choisir les canaux pertinents : SEO, social organique, newsletter, webinars, lead magnets, nurturing. Créer des parcours de conversion fluides — du contenu à la capture, jusqu'à la qualification et la prise de contact — et piloter la performance par funnel : trafic qualifié, conversion visitor-to-lead, opportunités générées. Pilier 2 — Content & Packaging des offres Traduire les expertises Mobsuccess en offres lisibles, désirables et activables commercialement : formaliser le positionnement, la promesse, les bénéfices, les cas d'usage, les preuves et les différenciants de chaque offre. Construire la bibliothèque d'assets marketing et sales : pages offres, présentations, études de cas, articles de fond, comparatifs marché, POVs sectoriels, contenus événementiels et de nurturing. Prioriser les offres à pousser selon leur potentiel business, développer des formats plug & play pour accélérer la compréhension et la vente, et garantir la synchronisation avec les équipes Marketing & Communication. Pilier 3 — Sales Enablement & Performance Équiper les équipes commerciales pour passer d'une logique opportuniste à une logique orchestrée : messages de prospection par segment et cas d'usage, one-pagers, sales decks, battlecards, séquences email/LinkedIn, scripts de relance. Organiser la remontée terrain (objections, verbatims, motifs de gain/perte) et transformer ces signaux en contenus, campagnes et ajustements de l'offre. Définir les règles de passage marketing → sales et les critères de qualification. Définir les KPIs du pôle growth, mettre en place un cadre de test-and-learn et produire un reporting régulier avec une lecture business des résultats — dans une logique d'amélioration continue. 🚀 Expérience Vous avez entre 6 et 10 ans d'expérience minimum en growth marketing, demand generation, acquisition B2B ou go-to-market, idéalement dans des environnements exigeants et complexes : adtech, martech, SaaS B2B, media, contenu ou conseil. Vous avez déjà construit des mécaniques de croissance concrètes, en inbound comme en outbound. Vous avez déjà structuré des offres et piloté leur mise en marché. 🧠 Compétences clés Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils et la tech : vous avez déjà mis en place vous-même vos dispositifs growth, sans dépendre d'une équipe technique. Vous êtes un(e) excellent(e) communicant(e), aussi à l'aise pour défendre une vision devant un comité de direction que pour embarquer des équipes sales, des experts ou des créatifs. Vous maîtrisez les mécaniques de génération de demande B2B et l'analyse funnel, pipeline et performance. Vous savez structurer une proposition de valeur forte, produire vite, tester, apprendre et itérer en pilotant par la donnée. Vous avez une excellente culture du marketing digital et des standards élevés, sur le fond comme sur la forme. ⚡ Ce qui fera la différence Vous êtes autonome, orienté(e) business et animé(e) par un vrai esprit builder. Vous aimez mettre la main à la pâte, partir d'une page blanche, simplifier des sujets complexes et challenger l'existant, en allant vite sans sacrifier la qualité. Vous êtes à l'aise dans des environnements en construction, avec des périmètres qui évoluent vite, et vous aimez travailler de manière profondément cross-fonctionnelle. Vous avez envie de construire, à terme, votre propre équipe growth. VOTRE FUTUR ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL Nous vous attendons dans une entreprise en très forte croissance. Rejoignez des collaborateurs à la pointe de l’expertise contenu et média, en rejoignant un cadre aussi exigeant que bienveillant. Cette société vous offrira de belles perspectives d’évolution et vous permettra de booster vos compétences. Head of Growth & Operations — Openbase.ai Full-time | Remote | Reports directly to the Founder About Openbase Openbase.ai is an AI gateway that helps developers and businesses access multiple AI models through one API. We simplify model access, routing, and usage management so teams can focus on building AI products. Our MVP is ready. We are hiring a hands-on leader to own our go-to-market strategy, day-to-day business execution, and journey from launch to our first 10,000 users. The opportunity You will work directly with the founder to turn Openbase into a growing business with repeatable customer acquisition, strong retention, and disciplined operations. You will own the commercial execution: finding our first customers, testing acquisition channels, improving onboarding, building partnerships, and organizing the people and systems needed to grow. Our ambition is 10,000 users. Your responsibility is to build a credible, measurable path toward that goal, with clear milestones for activated developers, retained customers, paying accounts, and profitable usage. What you will own Go-to-market and customer acquisition Identify our strongest initial customer segments, including AI startups, independent developers, agencies, and software teams. Develop our positioning and explain why developers should choose Openbase. Launch and improve acquisition across X, SEO, visibility in AI search engines, developer communities, partnerships, and targeted outbound. Test paid campaigns with clear budgets, conversion tracking, and criteria for scaling or stopping. Build a growth roadmap with weekly experiments and monthly acquisition targets. Developer activation and retention Own the journey from website visit to signup, first successful API request, first payment, and ongoing usage. Work with engineering to remove onboarding friction and improve documentation, quickstarts, and integration examples. Speak directly with developers to understand why they try Openbase, keep using it, or leave. Establish onboarding communications, customer support processes, and reactivation campaigns. Turn successful customer implementations into case studies and referrals. Sales and partnerships Personally source and close early customers. Build a qualified pipeline of startups and businesses with recurring AI usage. Develop distribution partnerships with developer tools, AI communities, accelerators, and complementary platforms. Coordinate technical evaluations and customer requirements with engineering. Build a repeatable sales process as demand grows. Business execution and team management Translate company goals into weekly priorities, accountable owners, and delivery dates. Recruit and manage freelancers, agencies, and future hires across growth, content, developer relations, and customer success. Own marketing budget allocation and evaluate spending against business results. Coordinate customer needs with product and engineering priorities. Implement practical workflows and automation that reduce manual work. Metrics and commercial performance Maintain a dashboard covering acquisition, activation, retention, paying customers, and API usage. Track customer acquisition cost, conversion rates, and retention by channel. Separate customer spending from provider costs and Openbase’s retained revenue and gross profit. Monitor promotional credits and infrastructure costs so growth remains economically sound. Give the founder a clear weekly view of results, blockers, and decisions needed. What we are looking for Experience leading growth and commercial execution at an early-stage SaaS, API, developer-tools, or AI infrastructure company. Evidence of acquiring users from an early starting point, with specific numbers and your personal contribution. Understanding of developer audiences and how technical products earn adoption. Ability to understand an API integration, follow documentation, and discuss onboarding issues with engineers. Hands-on ability to run experiments, analyze funnels, conduct customer calls, and manage delivery. Experience managing budgets and external specialists. Strong written English, sound judgment, and comfort working directly with a founder. Experience with usage-based pricing, developer relations, technical SEO, and AI model platforms is particularly relevant. Why join Direct ownership of Openbase’s launch and growth. Close collaboration with the founder and engineering team. The opportunity to build the commercial function from its earliest stage. Scope to take on broader company leadership as the business grows. How to apply Send your CV or LinkedIn profile, together with brief answers to: Which product have you helped grow? Include starting users, ending users, timeframe, budget, and your exact role. Which acquisition channels produced retained or paying customers? How would you approach Openbase’s first 1,000 activated developers? What would you personally execute, and where would you use specialists? What are your location, availability, and compensation expectations? Include an example of a growth experiment or operating system you built. Share only information you are authorized to disclose. Originally listed on We Work Remotely.
